title: FRANCE 24 report: Lebanon’s displaced turn to private aid groups as state support struggles
summary: As the war continues in Lebanon, so do the waves of displacement. Thousands of families are leaving their homes, and searching for temporary shelter in a country already straining under the weight of war. Government aid is limited, so private groups are stepping in to fill the gap and ease the suffering. FRANCE 24’s Abdelkader Dermas and Cyril Payen report…
